title: Malvertising Sends Malware in Pieces, Then Makes the Browser Build the Executable
summary: A malvertising operation dubbed SourTrade is making victims' browsers build the final Windows executable themselves, using a legitimate Bun runtime as its base instead of serving one complete malicious file from a fixed URL.
